svg.text: GPU = graphics processing unit. HBM = high-bandwidth memory on the GPU. NIC = network interface card. HCA = Host Channel Adapter (NCCL's word for an

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: RDMA NIC). RDMA = Remote Direct Memory Access.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: OS = operating system. IOMMU = the unit that translates the memory addresses that devices use. SRD = Scalable Reliable Datagram, the AWS network

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: protocol that EFA uses. IPC_LOCK = a Linux permission that lets a container lock memory. RDMA pool = a named set of RDMA devices that a pod asks for by

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: DMA-BUF = a Linux feature that lets devices share a memory buffer. nvidia-peermem = the older NVIDIA kernel module for the same job. The picture does

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: not show the switches between the servers. Pod values are from the pages cited in the text next to this picture.
